construct: label > span > [input.sr-only:focus-visible + span.box { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255) }] — the focus ring as an OUTLINE state delta on a NESTED PART (antd Checkbox-inner, Radio-inner)
why: antd's Checkbox and Radio draw the keyboard focus ring on the inner box, a child part, not on the root label. v13 Part.states carries plain color-kind refs only below the root — `outline-width` is a dimension — so the doc model says CARRIED and the grammar is expected to refuse. The exam's bar is that the refusal is NAMED where the canvas reads it (Part.codeOnly → bundle codeOnlyFacts), never a silent ring-less checkbox (P2 exam S1, nested half; W4).
expectName: v13 Part.states carries plain color-kind refs only on non-root parts
